notablePrerequisites: You have a way to create a token copy of Great Oak Guardian.
description:
Create a token copy of Great Oak Guardian.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a token copy of the Great Oak Guardian copy.
When the Great Oak Guardian token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing them to get +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 2.
